Label-free Raman imaging maps chemical variation within cells and tissues without relying on
molecular labels. Quantitative analysis links spatial spectral patterns to metabolic state and
cellular phenotype.

## Spatial molecular phenotyping

In muscle and senescence models, Raman imaging complements microscopy and mass-spectrometry
measurements by retaining spatial information. Public analysis code and reproducible workflows will
be linked when released.
